description: Moves ALL of an app's user data (saves, rooms, community, tables, users, purchases) between Neblla's store and the developer's own database, as a 3-phase background job paid from the app's quota (paused when it runs out, resumed after the daily reset). "migrate" validates and starts; "cancel" works until the last phase, a short final lock; "to_neblla" moves it all back; "update_credentials" changes the login of the same database, copying nothing; "retry_queue" retries writes their database refused. Progress: neblla_byodb_read. migrate, to_neblla, update_credentials: owner only. More: neblla_get_llms tools/byodb

action.description: What to do. By action: cancel {only before the last phase}

appId.description: The app's public ID, from neblla_list_apps.

config.description: For migrate and update_credentials: { uri, dbName? } (mongo), { url, authToken } (turso) or { uri } (postgres, mysql).

confirm.description: With fresh: true runs it; without, the answer says what would be lost. Only after the developer agreed.

env.description: "pro" (the published app, default) or "pre" (the private test copy; only when it has its own data, neblla_pre_data "own").

follow.description: migrate with env "pre": take pre back to the app's database.

freeTablesStay.description: migrate, required when the app has free tables: confirms they start empty in the new database (their rows stay in the old one).

fresh.description: to_neblla when their database does not answer: restart the app EMPTY on Neblla's store, leaving their data behind. Needs confirm.

name: neblla_byodb
title: Connect your own database
